---
name: Feature request / 功能建议
about: Describe a user workflow and the capability it needs
---

## User workflow / 使用场景

What are you trying to do, and where does the current behavior get in the way?

## Proposed behavior / 期望行为

Describe the desired result, affected platform/runtime and any known permission or lifecycle constraints. Check the [roadmap](../../docs/support.md) for planned capabilities.

## Validation / 验收

How would a user verify the change works? Use synthetic examples and omit private account data.
